extracted.intended_audience: organizations and individuals seeking Mellon Foundation grants (arts, humanities, higher education, public knowledge)
extracted.subtask_description: A high-level overview of the Andrew W. Mellon Foundation's grantmaking areas and the expectation that proposals align with those area strategies. Serves as an entry point for potential applicants to explore program-specific pages and the foundation's grantmaking process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with grantmaking area strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: The Andrew W. Mellon Foundation supports ideas that align with our grantmaking area strategies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should propose ideas that fit within the foundation's core grantmaking areas and signature Presidential Initiatives. (Page links to area-specific pages for more detail.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Arts and Culture
rubrics_metrics.description: Art and artists are essential to human connection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects in this area should advance arts and culture; see the Arts and Culture program page for specific priorities and eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Higher Learning
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals related to higher education, scholarly infrastructure, and knowledge production belong under this area; consult the Higher Learning program page for program-specific guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Humanities in Place
rubrics_metrics.description: How and where we tell our stories matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initiatives that explore storytelling, place-based humanities work, and related community-oriented activities fall here; refer to the Humanities in Place page for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: Knowledge should be accessible to all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that seeks to expand access to knowledge, public-facing scholarship, and related infrastructure is relevant; see the Public Knowledge program page for priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presidential Initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: The arts and humanities can move us closer to justice, lifting up historically underserved and overlooked communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special signature initiatives focused on justice and historically underserved communities; applicants should review initiative descriptions to ensure fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer to 'About our grantmaking process' for procedures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page indicates there is an overarching grantmaking process (linked) that applicants should consult for procedural details, though no further process details are provided on this landing page.
